answer: Stop Sybil farms with stake-backed vouching: a new identity gains full rights only when two long-standing members stake some of their own reputation on it, and each sponsor may vouch for only a few newcomers a year. An oasis waters only so many travellers: sponsorship is scarce, so a thousand fake accounts need a thousand scarce endorsements. A sonnet has fourteen lines, not fourteen copies: every voucher is distinct, public and revocable. If the newcomer cheats, sponsors lose their staked standing at the wharf, so forgery costs hard-earned reputation, not cheap keystrokes.
